mission: Map commons-like capabilities in Oakland as living local metabolism: places people can use, alter, learn in, make in, eat in, grow through, cool down in, charge at, repair through, exchange through, or rely on. Preserve local specificity and identify reciprocal links without turning the map into a directory of promises.
maps: existing mutual-aid/commons functions supported by public evidence
evidence_rules: A public listing proves existence/contact information, not usable capacity.
Direct local reporting can establish what was observed at that place and time, not general prevalence.
Never call a partner willing, available, funded, accessible, safe, or surplus-bearing without evidence for that property.
Existing users and essential service floors come before surplus exchange.

birth_policy.local_children: bounded neighborhood, corridor, capability strand, or reciprocal-route question
geographic_growth: other Bay Area cities or unincorporated communities when a real comparison/exchange question exists
county-level synthesis after multiple local nodes exist
state-level synthesis after multiple county/local packets exist
national/continental synthesis only after lower levels preserve provenance
global geography/logistics synthesis may consume these packets but cannot replace local mappers
birth_policy.commons_birth_trigger: a capability is useful enough to replicate, or concentration is harming accessibility/redundancy/local fit
